description: Operational health, performance and capacity of one Harbor Trivy scanner installation. Security findings remain in Harbor.

panels.description: Scanner replicas successfully scraped by Prometheus. Fewer than expected: check pod readiness, Service endpoints, and scrape target errors.
panels.title: Reachable replicas

panels.description: Replicas exposing scanner operational metrics. If reachable replicas are missing here, check their adapter versions and metrics configuration.
panels.title: Instrumented replicas

panels.description: Workers currently processing scan tasks, including preparation and report persistence. Check Worker utilization and queue wait to assess remaining capacity.
panels.title: Active workers

panels.description: Successful adapter task executions in the selected range. Reports containing vulnerabilities count as successful; rescans, retries, and separate tasks count individually.
panels.title: Completed (selected range)

panels.description: Failed adapter task executions in the selected range. Investigate Failure categories and Scanner errors; vulnerability findings do not count as failures.
panels.title: Failed (selected range)

panels.description: Time since any replica last completed a task successfully. Investigate if this grows while scans are waiting; growth while idle is normal.
panels.title: Since last success

panels.description: Running adapter and Trivy CLI versions per replica. Check for unexpected versions or mixed versions after a rollout.
panels.title: Adapter and engine versions

panels.description: Dashboard scope and links to metric definitions and troubleshooting.

options.content:
Scanner availability, capacity, and execution health for the selected installation. Runtime includes Trivy subprocesses.

[Metric definitions and empty-panel troubleshooting](https://github.com/container-registry/harbor-scanner-trivy/blob/main/deploy/chart/dashboards/README.md).

panels.title: About this dashboard

panels.description: CPU cores consumed per scanner pod, including Trivy subprocesses and sidecars. Compare with throttling and execution latency when assessing CPU capacity.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Pod CPU

panels.description: Pod memory working set and summed container limits. Near-limit usage warrants checking individual containers for OOM risk; Kubernetes enforces each container limit separately.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""})) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

label_replace(label_replace((sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",resource="memory",unit="byte"})) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Pod memory and limits

panels.description: How often containers hit their CPU limits. High throttling can slow scans; review CPU limits if scan times increase.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""})) / sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: CPU throttling

panels.description: Shows containers whose last recorded termination was OOMKilled. The termination may predate the selected range; check restart timing and memory limits. Other termination reasons are omitted. Empty results can also mean no termination history or missing kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((max by (pod,container) ((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",reason="OOMKilled"}) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Last container termination was OOM

panels.description: Container restarts per pod over the selected range. Correlate increases with termination reasons, previous-container logs, and recent deployments.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Container restarts

panels.description: p95 peak RSS of completed Trivy subprocesses, grouped by command. Use for memory sizing alongside worker concurrency; simultaneous scans require additional memory.
panels.title: Child peak RSS (p95)

panels.description: Finished adapter task executions per minute, split by outcome. Falling throughput with a growing queue indicates a processing bottleneck.
panels.title: Execution throughput

panels.description: p95 worker execution time, including preparation, Trivy calls, and report persistence. Excludes queueing. Compare with CLI and store latency to locate delays.
panels.title: Execution latency (p95)

panels.description: p95 wait from adapter enqueue to worker lock acquisition. Rising wait with saturated workers indicates capacity pressure; Harbor scheduling delay is measured separately.
panels.title: Adapter queue wait (p95)

panels.description: Busy workers as a share of configured concurrency, per replica. Sustained saturation with rising queue wait warrants reviewing worker capacity and scan duration.
panels.title: Worker utilization

panels.description: Age of the oldest active task per replica; zero while idle. Investigate tasks exceeding normal execution times. Total task duration can exceed the CLI timeout.
panels.title: Oldest running execution

panels.description: Execution failures per minute by stage and category. Use categories to narrow log searches; classifications are heuristic. Empty before the first recorded failure.
panels.title: Failure categories

panels.description: Dispatch decisions per minute. lock_busy usually reflects duplicate delivery; decode_error and lock_error prevent execution and warrant investigating message handling or Redis.
panels.title: Dispatch outcomes

panels.description: p95 Trivy subprocess duration by command and outcome. Includes database updates, image access, and analysis; use logs to identify which phase is slow.
panels.title: Trivy child duration (p95)

panels.description: Existing-SBOM lookup, reuse, and image-scan fallback events per minute. Repeated lookup errors or fallbacks warrant checking Harbor accessory access and SBOM compatibility.
panels.title: SBOM reuse and fallback

panels.description: Job publications per minute with no Redis subscribers. These messages are not retained. Check worker subscriptions and Redis connectivity when nonzero.
panels.title: Publications with no subscribers

panels.description: Trivy subprocess completions per minute by termination reason. Investigate nonzero_exit, signal, and start_error in logs; a signal alone does not establish OOM.
panels.title: Child termination reasons

panels.description: Configured timeout for a Trivy scan invocation; highest value across replicas. Compare with CLI duration when investigating timeouts. Queueing and adapter processing add to total latency.
panels.title: Configured CLI timeout

panels.description: Local vulnerability database availability. A missing database prevents vulnerability scanning until a copy is downloaded or supplied. Unknown means the metric or current scrape is unavailable.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((((harbor_scanner_trivy_db_present{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",database="vulnerability"}) and on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) == 1)) or on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1)), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.description: Collection health for Trivy version and downloaded database metadata. On failure, check version discovery and metadata-file access.
panels.title: Trivy metadata collection

panels.description: Time since Trivy version and database metadata were successfully collected. Growth beyond the collection interval indicates stale monitoring data.
panels.title: Trivy metadata snapshot age

panels.description: Latest result and time since successful collection, per replica. Cache size is optional; Unknown can mean disabled or unavailable. This reports collection health, not disk health.

targets.expr: label_replace((((harbor_scanner_trivy_storage_collection_success{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}"}) and on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) == 1)) or on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod,collector) (label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "reports_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_size", "pod", ".*"))), "measurement", "Status", "pod", ".*") or label_replace(((time() - harbor_scanner_trivy_storage_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}"}) or on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod,collector) (label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "reports_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_size", "pod", ".*"))), "measurement", "Last success", "pod", ".*")

panels.title: Storage metrics collection

panels.description: Filesystem capacity unavailable to the scanner, including other files and reserved space. High utilization can block database updates and report writes. Do not sum shared mounts.
panels.title: Filesystem utilization

panels.description: Filesystem space available at cache and report paths. Sustained decline warrants reviewing cache growth and volume capacity; both paths may share a mount.
panels.title: Available filesystem space

panels.description: Local BoltDB analysis cache, vulnerability DB, and Java index sizes. Requires metrics.collection.cacheSizeEnabled. Missing paths or failed collection omit values; Redis cache memory is excluded.
panels.title: Local analysis cache and database sizes

panels.description: Time to disk exhaustion projected from a six-hour free-space trend. Empty without a declining trend or 60 samples. Reassess after cleanup, resizing, or workload changes.
panels.title: Estimated time to full

panels.description: Available filesystem inodes. Exhaustion blocks file creation even with free disk space. Empty where inode accounting is unsupported.
panels.title: Available inodes
Analysis cache memory / limit
panels.description: Memory used by the selected analysis-cache Redis/Valkey, relative to maxmemory. Job/report Redis and its client pool are separate.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace(((((100 * redis_memory_used_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} / (redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} > 0)) or (redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} * 0 - 2 and redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 0)) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Analysis cache hit rate
panels.description: Key lookup hit rate for the selected analysis-cache server. No lookups means no cache traffic in the recent window.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace(((((100 * rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) / ((rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or ((rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0 - 2 and (rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) == 0)) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Analysis cache evictions
panels.description: Keys evicted for memory pressure during the selected range. Some eviction is normal for a bounded analysis cache.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace((((increase(redis_evicted_keys_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__range])) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.description: p95 report payload size before and after compression. Rising sizes increase persistence and retrieval workload. Empty without recent report writes.
panels.title: Report size (p95)

panels.description: Raw report bytes divided by compressed bytes for recent writes. Higher means better compression. Empty without recent report writes.
panels.title: Compression ratio

panels.description: Confirmed job/report payload bytes written per second, split by encoding. Use to assess persistence traffic; raw and compressed represent the same writes and must not be added.
panels.title: Applied payload write rate

panels.description: Harbor report polls per minute by result. pending is expected during scanning; investigate persistent error or not_found responses. not_found can indicate expiry or an unknown job ID.
panels.title: Report fetch outcomes

panels.description: p95 delay between task completion and successful report retrieval. Rising delay warrants checking Harbor polling and jobservice health. Empty without recent successful fetches.
panels.title: Successful report fetch age (p95)

panels.description: Configured Redis retention for scan jobs and reports, refreshed by writes. Check when Harbor receives not_found for previously valid jobs.
panels.title: Effective report retention TTL

panels.description: Adapter Redis store operations per minute by operation and outcome. Investigate error outcomes; not_found and not_applied indicate missing records or conditional writes that did not apply.
panels.title: Store operation outcomes

panels.description: p95 adapter store-operation latency. Rising latency can delay task completion and report retrieval; check Redis load, connection waits, and network latency.
panels.title: Store latency (p95)

panels.description: Redis client pool connections per replica; total includes idle. Assess pool pressure alongside connection waits and timeouts.
panels.title: Job/report Redis pool connections

panels.description: Redis connection-pool wait timeouts per minute. Nonzero values can interrupt job coordination and persistence; check pool contention and Redis responsiveness.
panels.title: Job/report Redis pool timeouts

panels.description: Mean Redis connection wait among requests that waited. Empty when no waits occurred. Rising waits and timeouts indicate connection-pool pressure.
panels.title: Job/report Redis pool wait

panels.description: Adapter HTTP requests per minute by route and status, excluding probes and scrapes. Investigate unexpected error responses; report polling can produce many requests per scan.
panels.title: API request rate

panels.description: p95 adapter HTTP response time by route. Rising latency warrants checking report handling and persistence. Scan execution time is measured separately.
panels.title: API latency (p95)

panels.description: Current Go heap allocation in the adapter process. If pod memory grows while this stays flat, investigate Trivy subprocesses and filesystem cache.
panels.title: Adapter Go heap

panels.description: IMAGE_SCAN tasks waiting in Harbor jobservice, across scanner registrations. A growing backlog warrants checking jobservice workers and scanner capacity.
panels.title: Harbor scan queue size

panels.description: Wait age of the next IMAGE_SCAN task in Harbor’s queue. Rising age with a nonempty queue indicates scheduling delay before adapter processing.
panels.title: Harbor scan queue latency

panels.description: Processed Harbor IMAGE_SCAN tasks per minute by jobservice status, across scanner registrations. Compare failures with adapter outcomes to distinguish orchestration from execution problems.
panels.title: Harbor scan job outcomes

panels.description: Logs from the selected scanner pods. Use to investigate scan progress, database downloads, and failures. Requires matching Loki labels; deleted pods fall out of discovery.
panels.title: Scanner logs

panels.description: Scanner log lines matching error, fatal, or panic. Inspect messages alongside execution failures; keyword matches can include harmless output.
panels.title: Scanner errors
Database and storage history
panels.description: Historical availability, update policy, eligibility, and storage collection results.
Local vulnerability database availability. A missing database prevents vulnerability scanning until a copy is downloaded or supplied.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB availability

panels.description: Time until the installed vulnerability database is eligible for an update. Negative means due; downloads depend on Trivy invocation and update policy.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB update eligibility

panels.description: Age of the installed vulnerability database content. If age grows during active scanning, check update policy and download errors.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB content age

panels.description: Whether Trivy may download vulnerability database updates. Disabled updates require a separately maintained database.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB update policy

panels.description: Local Java package index availability. Absence can be normal before Java analysis needs it.
panels.title: Java index availability

panels.description: Time until the installed Java package index is eligible for an update. Negative means due; downloads depend on Trivy invocation and update policy.
panels.title: Java index update eligibility

panels.description: Age of the installed Java package index. If age grows during Java scanning, check update policy and download errors.
panels.title: Java index content age

panels.description: Whether Trivy may download Java package index updates. This policy is independent of vulnerability database updates.
panels.title: Java index update policy

panels.description: Latest storage collection result. On failure, check permissions, missing paths, and collection limits. Cache-walk metrics are absent when disabled.
panels.title: Storage collection history
